option_A.name: strict recursive complete whitelist plus exact original-byte safe streams
option_A.stdout: only if one strict duplicate-free JSON object, exact bytes equal summary.json and every branch passes reviewed field/type/string-source/size policy
option_A.stderr: empty bytes are safe exact; nonempty only under a separate complete safe grammar, otherwise UNKNOWN/private
option_A.raw_profile: default no binary upload; complete validated semantic records preserve all function/caller/time values, original binary hash/size labelled, not byte-archive claim
option_A.limitation: cannot guarantee durable unexpected-private raw retention after hosted-runner teardown

option_B.name: encrypted stdout/stderr-only escrow to workspace-held recipient
option_B.dependencies: existing runner openssl only; exact CMS authenticated-envelope command/version support requires independent tiny fixture validation after separate GO
option_B.proposed_primitive: OpenSSL3 CMS AuthEnvelopedData AES-256-GCM to approved public recipient certificate; no ad-hoc RSA bulk or unauthenticated enc fallback
option_B.key_boundary: workspace private decryption key0600 never enters Git/Actions; only public recipient certificate/SPKI identity is provided; ephemeral content key stays inside OpenSSL envelope implementation
option_B.plaintext_container: versioned bound header(source/control/run/attempt/case/stream/byte-length/plaintextSHA256) plus exact original stdout or stderr bytes, all inside authenticated encryption
option_B.uploaded: only ciphertext stream envelopes plus ciphertext length/SHA/public-recipient fingerprint and safe metadata
